items.contentSnippet:

Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49221668
Points: 269
# Comments: 117
items.creator: shaunpud

summaries.zh: 域名现在可以通过DNS声明正在出售。该功能基于新的DNS标准，允许域名所有者将“for-sale”标记添加到DNS记录中，以公开显示出售信息。此举简化了域名交易流程，提高了透明度。该规范由Specification网站发布，已在Y Combinator等平台引发讨论。
summaries.en: A new standard allows domain names to indicate they are for sale directly in the Domain Name System (DNS) via a specific record type, `DNS-For-Sale`. This innovation simplifies the process of selling domains by embedding the "for sale" status within the domain's DNS records, making it more visible and accessible to potential buyers. The specification is designed to streamline domain transactions and reduce reliance on third-party marketplaces.

items.title: Show HN: Wyzer Programming Language
items.content:
So i've been working on this project since a few days (or months i should say), it's called wyzer (meaning wiser) it's a statically typed, compiled, resource-oriented programming language with integrated distributed safety via choreographic programming and perceus memory model, The reason why i began this project is out of frustration from Rust, you see it does provide safety for your memory by the strict type checking but what it does not gurantee safety against are distributed deadlocks which is basically a few independent nodes or services wait permanently for resources or messages held by each other, forming a circular wait, the rest are cross-service correctness and protocol mismatch as well. If we are specific over here Wyzer works on mainly generalizing the concept of choreographic programming in a high level programming language because its the very few attempts of actually solving these gaps of safety. Instead of borrow checkers and lifetimes wyzer has linear/affine types and a perceus reference counting which is computationally much simpler for an LSP to understand as well

after 5 months of research and a few weeks of development i am soon going to release version 0.1.0 of it, if you would like to contribute to it you're most welcome!

Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49209385

Points: 211

summaries.zh: Wyzer是一种静态类型、编译型、面向资源的编程语言，通过编舞式编程和Perceus内存模型实现分布式安全。该项目旨在弥补Rust在分布式死锁、跨服务正确性和协议不匹配等方面的安全缺陷。Wyzer采用线性/仿射类型和Perceus引用计数，简化了内存管理。作者计划在5个月研究和几周开发后发布0.1.0版本，欢迎贡献。
summaries.en: Wyzer is a statically typed, compiled, resource-oriented programming language designed to address distributed safety issues, such as deadlocks and cross-service mismatches, which Rust cannot fully prevent. It generalizes choreographic programming in a high-level language, using linear/affine types and a simpler perceus reference counting model instead of borrow checkers. The developer, frustrated with Rust's limitations, has been working on Wyzer for months and plans to release version 0.1.0 soon, inviting contributions. (99 words)

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了如何通过批处理、算子融合和SIMD技术将PostgreSQL的查询性能提升300倍。主要优化包括将查询分批处理以提高效率，融合多个查询算子以减少中间结果，以及利用SIMD指令加速数据处理。这些改进显著提升了PostgreSQL在分析任务中的速度和响应能力。
summaries.en: The article discusses optimizing PostgreSQL for analytics by improving query performance through batching, operator fusion, and SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) techniques. These enhancements significantly speed up processing, achieving a 300x performance gain. The content focuses on query engine improvements, offering insights into how these methods reduce latency and increase throughput. The article includes technical details and practical implementation strategies. For further discussion, readers can refer to the linked comments. (98 words)

summaries.en: Bioengineered chewing gum is being developed to combat HPV and other microbes. The gum incorporates microcapsules containing enzymes that break down the outer layers of bacteria, viruses, and fungi, including HPV. When chewed, the gum releases these enzymes, offering a passive defense against infections. The innovation aims to provide a convenient and accessible method for reducing microbial exposure. Further research is needed to assess its effectiveness and practicality.
